record.one_liner: Cloud-based accounting software for small to medium-sized businesses, offering invoicing, payroll, and financial reporting.
record.auth_notes: Xero uses OAuth 2.0 for all API access. For multi-tenant web apps, the Authorization Code flow is standard. For mobile or desktop apps, the PKCE flow is used. For single-tenant, machine-to-machine integrations, a premium "Custom Connection" option using the client credentials grant type is available.
record.access_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Xero account and use the Developer Portal to create an app and get credentials. However, API access is governed by a tiered pricing model effective March 2026. A free "Starter" tier exists but is limited to 5 connections and 1,000 daily API calls per organization. To exceed 5 connections, developers must upgrade to a paid tier, which also increases the daily call limit to 5,000 and provides a data egress allowance with overage fees. Access to premium APIs like Xero Practice Manager requires separate approval.
record.api_notes: Extensive REST API covering Accounting (Invoices, Contacts, Bank Transactions), Assets, Files, Payroll, Projects, and Expenses. Official OpenAPI specifications are provided for all API sets.
record.mcp_notes: Xero has published an official, open-source MCP server on GitHub. It acts as a bridge between the MCP protocol and the Xero API, supporting authentication via Custom Connections or bearer tokens.
record.blocker_notes: The primary blocker is the new pricing model. While not an absolute stop, the cost associated with scaling beyond 5 connections is a significant point of friction.

evidence.quote: Xero is a suite of online accounting software for small businesses and their advisors.

Xero's API supports the authorization code grant type using the standard authorization code flow or the Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) extension. We also have a premium integration option called Custom Connections which utilises the client credentials grant type.
The authorization code flow is used by web and mobile apps to get an access token to call Xero APIs.
App pricing is a flat monthly fee based on tier and includes a set allotment of data consumption via the Xero APIs.

New apps created in the Xero Developer portal will default to the Starter tier. The Starter tier has unlimited data access to enable early innovation but is capped at 5 connections. In order to add a 6th connection, you will need to first add your payment details. Once that is complete, you will move to the Core tier.
We provide OpenAPI specifications for all our APIs to help you get started.
Webhooks allow your app to receive notifications about events that happen in a Xero organisation.
The Accounting API is a RESTful web service...
The Demo Company is a great way to test your integration...
We've developed an MCP server that seamlessly integrates with Xero's public API, allowing LLMs to interact with business data in a secure and efficient way.
Xero's official MCP server is published as an open-source GitHub repository for developer-run local setups.
App pricing is a flat monthly fee based on tier and includes a set allotment of data consumption via the Xero APIs.

Designed to meet developers where they are in their app development journey, we are transitioning to five tiers: Starter, Core, Plus, Advanced, Enterprise based on connections and data consumption via the Xero APIs.
